audio_clips.text: "Hosico in a transparent cat backpack is carried through a park, then the carrier sits on a bench."
"At night, Hosico sits in a transparent cat backpack on a wooden bench. The front opens, revealing Hosico looking curious. He extends his paw, exploring."
"Hosico, still in transparent backpack, sits calmly on a spinning playground merry-go-round."
"Hosico sits in a transparent backpack on a swinging playground swing, looking curious. Soon, Hosico is outside, wearing a harness and leash, exploring the artificial grass."
"Hosico, in a green harness, walks on artificial grass, stopping to sniff, while a person walks alongside."
"Hosico, stops near a slide, and looks curious as someone approaches."
"A person on a playground holds a green leash connected to Hosico. The cat stands and starts walking forward."
"Hosico walks toward a transparent backpack. Assisted by a person, Hosico enters the backpack. The person lifts the backpack and walks along a park pathway."

video_name: Hosico's Adventures in a Cat Backpack
